second-user.evidence: Seed creates regular user mara / tester1234 (may_upload, may_edit_own_settings, not admin) via POST /api/v2/UserManagement. Verify asserts users == [admin, mara].

nested-albums.evidence: Album Nordic Coast 2026 has child album Lofoten Islands; lychee:sync builds the tree from the fixture directories and verify reads it back through /api/v2/Album::albums.

shared-album.evidence: Studio Sessions is shared with mara with grants_edit/grant_download; verify reads /api/v2/Sharing?album_id=... and confirms mara sees the album in shared_albums and can list its 4 photos.

public-album.evidence: Archive 2024 is public (is_public, no link requirement): a guest session gets Album::head 200 with 4 photos and Album::photos total=4.

photo-metadata.evidence: 17 photos with fixed titles (fixture filenames), descriptions (4 empty as a realistic edge case), unique tag sets, and taken/upload dates in 2024 and 2026 fixed through PATCH /api/v2/Photo.

photo-ratings.evidence: Admin ratings 0-5 across the 17 photos via Photo::setRating; verify asserts per-photo rating_user.

highlighted-photos.evidence: 4 photos flagged is_highlighted (former is_starred) through Photo::highlight; verify asserts the exact 4 titles.

empty-unsorted.evidence: All photos land in fixture albums; verify asserts the Unsorted smart album total is 0.

client-side-favourites.evidence: Lychee v7 favourites are a client-side persisted store (resources/js/stores/FavouriteState.ts); server-side metrics that count them are disabled by default and skip admins. Assert favourites only after a browser user action, never as seeded baseline.
